lemma_statement: ∃ b : c(ℕ, HaloInt p), cfunSlash hp2 ω (mahlerEmbed a) g = mahlerEmbed b ∧ ∀ m, T^m * b m = ∑' n, a n * T^n * entry ω (M1.toLocalMat g) m n
b2_reason: FALSE as stated: the T-rescaled transport forces b m = Δ̃^m F 0 / T^m, which is not c₀. Counterexample: a = single 0 1, g = [[p,0],[p,1]] ∈ M1 (even IsUpShape): F z = (1+T)^{qlog(1+pz)/p} with qlog(1+pz)/p = z + p·w(z), so the T^m-coefficient of Δ̃^m F 0 is 1 + O(p⁻¹) (Ring.choose is 1-Lipschitz), giving ‖b m‖ = 1 for every m. [LWX, Prop 3.4] itself expands the slash in the PLAIN Mahler basis, where the matrix is exactly entry ω δ m n and c₀ IS preserved (column decay p^{n−m}); the T-rescaling lives in the ESTIMATES (Prop 3.14), not in the module coordinates. Fix: restate via the plain embedding mahlerON a = ∑' n, a n · const(binom z n): ∃ b, cfunSlash hp2 ω (mahlerON a) g = mahlerON b ∧ ∀ m, b m = ∑' n, a n * entry ω (M1.toLocalMat g) m n. Renamed cfunSlash_mahlerON.

lemma_statement: mahlerEmbed (slash a g) = cfunSlash hp2 ω (mahlerEmbed a) g
b2_reason: Same defect propagated: the bridge along the T-rescaled mahlerEmbed cannot hold with slash valued in c(ℕ, HaloInt p) (the forced coefficients are not c₀, see cfunSlash_mahlerEmbed entry). Fix: bridge along the plain embedding: mahlerON (slash a g) = cfunSlash hp2 ω (mahlerON a) g. Renamed mahlerON_seqSlash.

lemma_statement: T^m * (slash a g) m = ∑' n, a n * T^n * entry ω (M1.toLocalMat g) m n
b2_reason: Weights tuned to the false T-rescaled transport. The intertwining with UpDatum.op (whose matrix is the raw entry ω δ m n, as proved in D4 and consumed by F2/F3) requires the plain form. Fix: (slash a g) m = ∑' n, a n * entry ω (M1.toLocalMat g) m n. Statement corrected in place, name kept.
